text:
Incident Bot: INCIDENT opened — elevated latency and 5xxs originating in eu-central-1 impacting Hosted API and Dedicated pools. Pager INC-34567 created. Linking logs + trace: https://internal.observability/trace/INC-34567 :rotating_light:
Sara R.: I'm taking first touch. Seeing token-exchange failures to thirdparty-auth.eu (502/504) around 10:01 UTC, coincident with a spike in request latency to model-serving.
Mike L.: Confirmed. 5xx rate peaked ~12% for eu-central nodes. Dedicated pools in eu-central showing queue depth growth and KV cache timeouts.
Anya P.: Auth vendor status page shows degraded region eu-central: https://status.thirdparty-auth/eu-central — looks like rate limiting on their token endpoint.
Sara R.: Mitigation plan: 1) enable routing fallback to eu-west-1/us-west-2 for new sessions; 2) switch token caching to extended TTL when possible; 3) throttle non-critical background jobs. Kicking step 1 now.
Mike L.: Pushing routing override via control-plane: ``POST /v1/routing/overrides 
{"match": {"region":"eu-central-1","service":"text-generation"}, "route_to": ["eu-west-1","us-west-2"], "weight": [0.0, 1.0]}`` — applied.
Incident Bot: On-call assigned: Sara R. (primary), escalation to Mike L. after 15m if not resolved. PagerDuty alert pinned: INC-34567.
Leo K.: Network team — we see no VPC-level egress errors; tracing shows the control plane calls to the vendor are returning 502s with short TCP resets from their edge.
Sara R.: Customer impact estimate: ~6% of hosted API requests in EU saw 5xx; Dedicated throughput degraded for ~8% of reserved pools in region for ~18 minutes. No P1 customer pages yet, but a SMB customer reported errors via support.
Mike L.: Rolling an automatic degrade: for requests that hit auth failure, fallback to cached token path and reduce concurrency to affected hosts. Patch applied to token refresher.
Anya P.: Observability note: enabling synthetic probes to vendor endpoints at 30s cadence to detect residual flapping.
Sara R.: Error rate down to 1.1% in eu-central after routing shift and TTL tweak. Latency back to normal for most flows. Keeping pager open and monitoring for 30m.
PagerDuty: Incident INC-34567 acknowledged by Sara R. at 10:09 UTC.
Mike L.: Handing off to Leo for follow-up and post-incident networking verification. @Leo K. can you own the postmortem section on external dependency risk and a recommended fallback playbook? :handshake:
Leo K.: On it — I'll coordinate with vendor SRE contacts and draft follow-up.
Sara R.: Thanks all — will close pager after 30m of stable metrics and then create a short postmortem with RCA and next steps (caching policy, routing heuristics, vendor contractual SLO check). :white_check_mark:
